message.reasoning:
With only one house and $475 left, I'm considering whether to use that last house to push a light blue property to four houses so I can convert to a hotel, since building a hotel frees up houses back to the bank for future use.

Actually Illinois is the most frequently landed-on red, so upgrading it from 3 to 4 houses raises rent from 750 to 925 for just $150 — better value than the other options. I'll build there instead.
